goal: Inspect installed native delivery control switches and revisions in public.communication_delivery_controls governing whether native delivery templates and notification controls are enabled (delivery controls, kill switch, email send gate).

absentMeans.description: When public.communication_delivery_controls has no row for a control key, native communications control-plane preparation treats absent control keys as disabled (false) and refuses delivery preparation with communications_delivery_disabled (the table column default is false; lifecycle notice checks via communications_notification_control_enabled only block explicitly false rows).
absentMeans.source: no installed control row (absent control keys default to disabled / false in native control-plane delivery preparation)

whyThisDefault: Native control-plane delivery starts disabled until an authorized operator creates and enables a control row and active template binding.

effect.appliesTo: Controls native communications delivery eligibility in public.communication_delivery_controls (control_key, enabled, revision), evaluated when preparing new delivery commands and lifecycle notification gates. Because public.communication_delivery_controls has REVOKE ALL from default roles (PUBLIC, anon, authenticated), connected reads require an explicit SELECT grant on public.communication_delivery_controls (otherwise returning commerce_setting_read_unavailable).
frozenOn: Already accepted delivery commands, recorded delivery receipts, and append-only delivery events replay and retain their stored outcomes.

runtime.reason: Managed through operator-authorized database routine communications_set_delivery_control; connected CLI reads require explicit SELECT permission on public.communication_delivery_controls.

goal: Set how many days terminal processed and discarded outbox event payloads and errors are retained before compaction clears them (outbox retention, payload pruning, compaction days).
whyThisDefault: Thirty days for processed events and ninety days for discarded events preserve recent audit and troubleshooting evidence while bounding table payload growth.

effect.appliesTo: Passed as processedDays and discardedDays (integers 1..3650) to createOutbox(..., { prune: { enabled: true, processedDays, discardedDays, ... } }) or createPostgresOutboxCompactor().compact({ processedDays, discardedDays, limit }) from @openlup/outbox. Clears payload and error on processed rows older than processedDays and discarded rows with a valid metadata.discardedAt older than discardedDays while retaining the event row, unique enqueue key, and retentionCompacted* metadata.
frozenOn: Already compacted event rows, pending/failed/processing events, and rows marked metadata.retainPayload=true keep their current state.

runtime.reason: Configured in server outbox composition via createPostgresOutboxCompactor().compact({ processedDays, discardedDays, limit }) or createOutbox prune options from @openlup/outbox and applied on deployment.
